story:
Ethan ran through the bright, crowded rec room before anyone else arrived, because he wanted the best chair near the big screen. Three chairs were set up around the glowing monitor, which was much more exciting than he had thought it would be. [emotion:QT/happy] [emotion:QT/surprised] When a boy named Ravi sat down beside him, Ethan felt a little surprised. Ravi looked at the screen and said, "That treasure chest is really far from here — I think we have to cross the red bridge first."

Ethan had already tried to reach the chest by charging straight ahead, but that path was blocked. [emotion:QT/angry] Although Ethan felt frustrated, he listened while Ravi explained a different route through the narrow, twisted tunnels.

"If we take turns choosing each path," Ravi said, "then we can cover more ground faster."

After that, they went through three tricky levels together. [gesture:clapping] Finally, the golden chest swung open, and both of them cheered so loudly the chairs shook. [emotion:QT/happy] Ravi gave Ethan a high-five and grinned. [emotion:QT/happy] "We figured it out because we worked together."

scenes: Ethan and Ravi sitting side by side in chairs in a bright, crowded rec room, looking at a glowing monitor showing a treasure chest and a red bridge

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and Ravi's treasure quest?
questions.correct_answer: Working together helps you reach the treasure faster
wrong_answers: Charging straight ahead is the best strategy
The first player to arrive always wins the game

questions.question: Before Ravi arrived, where did Ethan run to grab the best chair in the rec room?
questions.correct_answer: Near the big screen and glowing monitor
wrong_answers: Next to the treasure chest in the corner
Beside the red bridge at the back of the room

questions.question: After Ethan tried charging straight ahead, what three things did Ravi think they should do to reach the treasure chest?
questions.correct_answer: Cross the red bridge, go through twisted tunnels, and take turns choosing each path
wrong_answers: Run faster, grab a power-up, and race through three open roads
Find a superhero cape, rescue a helper character, and reach the secret base

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt frustrated when his straight-ahead path was blocked by the obstacle in the game?
questions.correct_answer: He thought charging ahead would work and was wrong
wrong_answers: He was angry because Ravi chose the best chair first
He felt frustrated because the treasure chest was already open

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had not listened while Ravi explained the route through the tricky tunnels?
questions.correct_answer: They probably would have stayed stuck and never reached the treasure
wrong_answers: Ethan would have charged through three levels and won alone
Ravi would have crossed the red bridge and grabbed the chest by himself

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Working together helps you solve hard problems faster.
wrong_answers: Being the first to arrive gives you the best chance of winning.
Knowing the game better than anyone else is the key to success.

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to listen to Ravi's plan?
questions.correct_answer: Listening to a friend's idea can get you further than going alone.
wrong_answers: Asking for help means you are not good enough to play on your own.
Waiting for someone else to lead is the easiest way to finish a game.

questions.question: What did Ethan and Ravi show us by what they did?
questions.correct_answer: Sharing chances and taking turns makes the game better for everyone.
wrong_answers: Choosing every path yourself helps the team move through levels more quickly.
Playing in a big, crowded room makes it easier to find the right answer.

takeaways: Working together helps you solve hard problems faster.
Listening to a friend's idea can get you further than going alone.
Sharing chances and taking turns makes the game better for everyone.
